You were the last person with an account in this family. Its information is still saved. Write down this code: whoever enters it when creating their account will be linked to your person and carry on with everything.\n\n%1$s
Your account has been deleted. The family\'s information is still saved.

Your account will be removed from the app and you\'ll lose access to this family and stop receiving alerts. Your person and their whole history stay in the family, and someone else can be linked to them again. This can\'t be undone.
Couldn\'t delete the account. Check your connection and try again.
Couldn\'t unlink the account. Please try again.
%1$s isn\'t allowed to schedule alarms at an exact time, so your phone may delay activity alerts by several minutes. To make them go off exactly on time, turn on “Alarms & reminders” for %1$s.
%1$s has no battery restrictions. If alerts still don\'t reach you with the app closed, your phone may have its own manufacturer power saving.

Your phone\'s battery saver can stop alerts from arriving when %1$s isn\'t open on screen. To avoid this, remove the battery restrictions: the %1$s settings page will open. Go to “Battery” and choose “Unrestricted” (depending on your phone, it may be called “Don\'t optimize”).
The people in the family and the groups that go together.
They\'ll be removed from the list, their account will lose access, the family units they belong to will be deleted and their assigned activities will have no one in charge. This can\'t be undone.
Their account will lose access to the family\'s data and stop receiving alerts. %1$s will stay on the list and you can invite them again.

If you\'re the one signed in, use the person icon to link yourself to your own caregiver.
Groups of caregivers who go together (e.g. the maternal grandparents), so you can assign them to a day all at once.
The people in the group stay on the list; only the group disappears. This can\'t be undone.
